routing.question_instructions: Which route fits the work this Kanban card asks for?

routes.name: easy
routes.criterion: The card names the exact files to change and the exact command that checks the result, and the worker has no behaviour to work out. The topic of the card does not matter.

routes.name: medium
routes.criterion: A fully specified change across several files with no design decision. This includes tests, fixtures, user-facing text and wiring inside security, migration or deployment features.

routes.name: hard
routes.criterion: Everything else: a design decision, a fault with an unknown cause, logic for authentication, secrets or payment, writing a database migration, or commands that will be run against production, including deployment guides.
